text: What do five beers do to me?

steps.title: Alcohol builds up
steps.say: Five beers arrive faster than your liver can clear them, so alcohol sits in your blood for hours. You may feel relaxed, then clumsy and sleepy.

steps.title: Your liver queues everything
steps.say: Your liver handles alcohol first, at a fixed pace. Meanwhile pizza fat and sugar wait and get stored, so more ends up as body fat.

steps.title: Still there at 02:00
steps.say: Even by 02:00 some alcohol remains, and the bladder is filling fast. You may feel dehydrated, sleep lightly and wake up rough.

lines.text: Five beers would keep alcohol in your blood well past midnight, still present around 02:00.
Your liver clears alcohol first, so pizza and sugar get stored as fat meanwhile.
You may feel sleepy, wake often, and be dehydrated tomorrow. Coffee won't cancel it out.
